# Best Endgame Builds for Dark Souls Remastered

There's no single "best" build, but here are the top-tier options:

## **1. Quality Build (Most Versatile)**
- **Stats:** 40 VIT / 40 END / 40 STR / 40 DEX
- **Weapons:** Claymore, Halberd, Great Scythe
- **Why:** Uses almost any weapon effectively, great for first playthrough

## **2. Strength Build (Highest Damage)**
- **Stats:** 40 VIT / 40 END / 50+ STR / Min DEX
- **Weapons:** Zweihander, Great Club, Man-Serpent Greatsword
- **Why:** Massive damage per hit, staggers everything

## **3. Dex/Pyro Hybrid (PvE King)**
- **Stats:** 40 VIT / 30-40 END / 45 DEX / 40+ ATT
- **Weapons:** Quelaag's Furysword, Great Scythe + Pyromancy
- **Why:** Fast weapons + powerful pyromancies (no stat scaling needed)

## **4. Giant Dad (Meme/PvP)**
- **Stats:** 48 VIT / 66 END / 16 STR / 10 DEX
- **Gear:** Giant Armor, Mask of the Father, Zweihander, Grass Crest Shield
- **Why:** Maximum poise + fast rolls with Havel's Ring + FaP Ring

## **Quick Tips:**
- Always get 40 VIT and 40 END minimum
- Stop at 40 in damage stats (soft cap) unless pure STR
- Upgrade weapons to +15 (or unique paths)
- Fast roll (<25% equip load) is crucial

What playstyle interests you most?
